method: Native in-app browser interaction and screenshot inspection; observations recorded by the implementing agent

viewports.scope: all three variants; same initial data and quantity=3 screenshots
all three variants; long blueberry title; panels fit; world six-column navigation
ledger only; final blank-page placement; 755px client/scroll height; font loaded
ledger reflow; no horizontal page overflow; vertical panel scrolling; focus scrolls quantity into view

observations: Buy 3 cabbage: 240 to 204 money, used slots 9 to 12 of 24, owned 2 to 5, stock 12 to 9.
Switch to ledger retains purchased state and quantity.
12 money plus radish at 18: shortfall 6, button disabled, no debit.
Full bag and sold-out fixtures: reason visible, purchase disabled, no debit.
Quantity 1.5: integer validation message, purchase disabled.
World variant begins at entry; E opens, Escape closes and restores entry focus.
Arrow navigation follows three-column narrow grid and six-column short desktop grid.
Longest blueberry title wraps without horizontal overflow; sold-out state remains readable.
Three final screenshots display same item identity, same green purchase action and separately rendered Chinese content.
At 390x844, description computed as 16px system-ui, heading as 24px FusionPixel; document.fonts.check returned true.
No captured console warnings or errors at final check.
limits: No player usability study, screen-reader, physical touch device or controller testing.
No roaming world, production persistence or complete farming systems.
Reduced-motion CSS inspected; no running animation loop exists. OS preference switching was not tested.
Image grain, finite palette and object-by-object light/projection have not passed production review. Item atlas binary alpha fails.
Viewport checks are scoped above, not every variant at every possible size.
